Based on the text provided, Warfarin is an anticoagulant used to prevent harmful blood clots. Its primary effect is the prevention of clot formation, which is critical for patients at high risk. However, it carries significant risks, including severe bleeding. Minor side effects mentioned are bruising, while more severe complications can include bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract or the brain.

Regarding your second question, the largest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.
